intent: Generate a verified Anki .apkg deck so JS/TS Array, String, Map/Set/Object/Math and sort/destructuring idioms can be memorized for LeetCode.
scope: New package python_pkg/js_anki (models, verify, deck, cli, runner.js, 3 JSON data files, tests)
genanki added to meta/requirements-test.txt and the pylint hook additional_dependencies
Non-goals: no type-in cards, no add-ons, .apkg is a gitignored build artifact
changes: 98 entries -> 199 flip/self-grade cards (task, behaviour, argument-order) in JS::Array, JS::String and JS::Extras subdecks plus ::Rare tiers
Every example is executed in Node during the build and the build exits 1 if any result differs from the stated one
Deterministic model/deck ids and note GUIDs so re-importing updates cards instead of duplicating

verification.evidence: User imported into desktop Anki and confirmed the cards look ok

risks: Node must be on PATH to build the deck
LeetCode's Node version may lack ES2023 methods (toSorted, findLast) on older runtimes
rollback: git revert the commit; delete python_pkg/js_anki/build/
Remove the imported JS deck from Anki
